source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 1 exercise hal (PDF 19-21): MCQs ke jawab aur wajah, short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Periodic Table and Periodic Properties) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. Which scientist first time observed the periodicity in the elements?
(Kis scientist ne sab se pehle elements mein periodicity (khasiyaton ka baar baar dohraana) dekhi?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter (1.1) ke mutabiq 1864 mein John Newlands ne 62 maloom elements mein sab se pehle periodicity dekhi: atomic mass ki tarteeb mein har aathwan element pehle jaisa tha. Döbereiner (1829) ne triads banaye; Mendeleev (1869) aur Meyer baad mein aaye.

blocks.prompt:
II. Recognize the element if it has 3 electron shells, belongs to “s” block and has 2 electrons in its outer most shell.
(Woh element pehchanein jis ke 3 shells hon, "s" block mein ho aur bahar wale shell mein 2 electrons hon.)
blocks.explanation: 3 shells = period 3; s block aur 2 valence electrons = group 2. Yeh magnesium hai: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² (1.6). Calcium ke 4 shells hain; sodium ka sirf 1 bahar wala electron hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. Which one do you think is correct about metallic character?
(Metallic character (electron chhorne ka rujhan) ke baare mein kaun si baat durust hai?)

options.text: Group mein oopar se neeche kam hota hai.
Group mein oopar se neeche barhta hai.
Period mein baen se daen yaksaan rehta hai.
Period mein baen se daen barhta hai.

blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche size aur shielding barhte hain, is liye valence electron asani se nikalta hai: metallic character barhta hai (Cs, Na se zyada metallic). Period mein baen se daen kam hota hai (1.7.8).

blocks.prompt:
IV. Which one is the correct statement among the following?
(In mein se kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Anion ka radius aam tor par atom se chhota hota hai.
Cation ka radius aam tor par atom se bara hota hai.
Cation ka ionic radius aam tor par atom se chhota hota hai.
Anion aur cation dono ke radius atom se chhote hote hain.

blocks.explanation: Cation apne atom se chhota hota hai (electron nikalne se repulsion kam, baqi electrons nucleus ke qareeb); anion apne atom se bara hota hai (1.7.2). Misal: Na 186 pm, Na⁺ 95 pm; Cl 99 pm, Cl⁻ 181 pm.

blocks.prompt:
V. Which property increases as you go down a group in the periodic table?
(Periodic table ke group mein neeche jaate hue kaun si khasiyat barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche naye shells judte hain, is liye atomic radius barhta hai; electron affinity, electronegativity aur ionization energy kam hoti hain (1.7.1, 1.7.3-1.7.7).

blocks.prompt:
VI. Which set of the following conditions results in higher ionization energy?
(Kaun si halat zyada ionization energy deti hai?)

options.text: Chhota atom aur zyada nuclear charge.
Chhota atom aur kam nuclear charge
Bara atom aur zyada nuclear charge
Bara atom aur kam nuclear charge

blocks.explanation: Nuclear charge zyada ho to ionization energy zyada; atom bara ho to kam. Is liye chhota atom aur zyada nuclear charge electron ko sab se mazbooti se pakarta hai (1.7.3).

blocks.prompt:
VII. Which of the following atoms show more than one (variable) oxidation states?
(Kaun sa atom aik se zyada (variable) oxidation states dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus +3 (P₄O₆, PCl₃) aur +5 (P₄O₁₀, PCl₅) dikhata hai kyun ke khali 3d orbitals ki madad se octet barha sakta hai; Na (+1), Mg (+2), Al (+3) sirf aik state dikhate hain (1.10).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (d) "Phosphorous" chhapa hai; element ka sahi naam phosphorus hai. Yahi ghalti short sawal (h) mein bhi hai.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Which is the correct general trend in the variation of electron affinity in a group?
(Group mein electron affinity ka aam rujhan (trend) kya hai?)

options.text: Oopar se neeche kam negative hoti jaati hai.
Oopar se neeche zyada negative hoti jaati hai.
Koi khaas trend nahi, be-qaida badalti hai.

blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche atom bara hota hai, aane wale electron par kashish kam, kam energy kharij hoti hai: electron affinity kam negative (Li −60 se Cs −46 kJ mol⁻¹); fluorine istisna (exception) hai (1.7.5).

blocks.prompt:
IX. What is the oxidation state of sulfur in the sulfate ion (SO₄²⁻).
(Sulfate ion (SO₄²⁻) mein sulfur ki oxidation state kya hai?)

X. Which is the correct trend in variation of electronegativity along a period of the periodic table?
(Period mein electronegativity ka sahi trend kya hai?)

options.text: Period mein baen se daen kam hoti hai.
Period mein baen se daen barhti hai.

blocks.explanation: Period mein nuclear charge barhta aur size ghatta hai, is liye electronegativity barhti hai (Li 1.0 se F 4.0) (1.7.7).

blocks.prompt:
XI. The atomic radius generally…….. across a period in the periodic table.
(Period mein baen se daen atomic radius aam tor par …….. hai.)
blocks.explanation: Period mein shells utne hi rehte hain magar nuclear charge barh kar electron cloud ko qareeb kheenchta hai, is liye atomic radius ghatta hai (1.7.1).

blocks.prompt:
XII. Which one of the following elements has the highest ionization energy?
(In mein se kis element ki ionization energy sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaaron period 3 mein hain. Argon noble gas hai jis ka shell 3s² 3p⁶ poora bhara hai, is liye period mein us ki ionization energy sab se zyada hai (1.7.3).

blocks.text: Q.2 Darj zail sawalon ke mukhtasar jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. What is 1st ionization energy? Give an example.
Pehli ionization energy kya hai? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Gas halat ke aik mole atoms ke har atom se aik electron nikaal kar aik mole 1+ ions banane ke liye darkaar energy (ΔHᵢ₁).
Misal: Na(g) → Na⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁ = 494 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
b. Explain why sulfur has a lower first ionization energy than phosphorus.
Wazahat karein ke sulfur ki pehli ionization energy phosphorus se kam kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: P (3s² 3p³) ka 3p subshell aadha bhara (half-filled) aur mustahkam hai, electron nikalna mushkil. S (3s² 3p⁴) mein aik 3p orbital mein do paired electrons hain; un ki repulsion (dhakelna) se aik electron asani se nikal jata hai. Is liye S ki IE < P ki IE.

blocks.prompt:
c. Why the elements in Group 13 to 17 are called p-block elements?
Group 13 se 17 ke elements p-block kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke in ke aakhri (valence) electrons p orbitals mein jaate hain; valence shell ns² np¹ se ns² np⁵ tak hai (group 18, ns² np⁶, bhi p block hai).

blocks.prompt:
d. What are the factors that affect electronegativity?
Electronegativity par asar daalne wale factors kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Atomic size: atom bara to electronegativity kam (F > Cl > Br > I).
2. Effective nuclear charge: charge zyada to electronegativity zyada; is liye period mein barhti hai (Li 1.0, F 4.0).

blocks.prompt:
e. What factors are responsible for the the increasing reactivity of alkali metals as you move down the group?
Group mein neeche jaate hue alkali metals ki reactivity barhne ki wajah kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche: atomic size aur andar ke shells ki shielding barhti hai, akela valence electron dheela pakra jata hai; ionization energy kam hoti hai (Li > Na > K > Rb > Cs), electron asani se nikalta hai, is liye reactivity barhti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein lafz do dafa chhapa hai: "for the the increasing reactivity"; aik "the" zaid hai.

blocks.prompt:
f. Why some of the elements show variable oxidation numbers while others do not?
Kuch elements variable oxidation numbers kyun dikhate hain aur kuch nahi?
blocks.explanation: Oxidation number = bonding mein istemal hone wale electrons. P aur S ke paas khali 3d orbitals hain; paired electrons ko un mein bhej kar (octet barha kar) mukhtalif tadaad mein electrons istemal kar sakte hain (P: +3, +5; S: +4, +6). Na, Mg, Al ke paas yeh ikhtiyar nahi; woh sab valence electrons istemal karte hain (+1, +2, +3).

blocks.prompt:
g. Identify the element which is in period 5 and group 15?
Period 5 aur group 15 wala element pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: Antimony (Sb, Z = 51): 5 shells, valence configuration 5s² 5p³ (5 valence electrons, p block).

blocks.prompt:
h. Why oxides of sodium and magnesium are more ionic than the oxides of nitrogen and phosphorous?
Sodium aur magnesium ke oxides nitrogen aur phosphorus ke oxides se zyada ionic kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Na aur Mg metals hain, electronegativity kam (0.9, 1.2); O (3.5) se farq bara hai, is liye electron muntaqil hote hain aur giant ionic lattice banti hai (Na₂O, MgO). N (3.0) aur P (2.1) non-metals hain, farq kam hai, is liye electrons share karte hain aur covalent molecules bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
i. Give reason for the different chemical reactivities of Na and Mg toward oxygen and chlorine.
Oxygen aur chlorine ke saath Na aur Mg ki mukhtalif reactivity ki wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Na sirf aik electron chhorta hai (IE kam, 494 kJ mol⁻¹) aur bara hai, is liye zyada metallic aur tez reaction (sunehri peeli lau; kerosene mein rakha jata hai). Mg ko do electrons chhorne parte hain (kul IE zyada) aur chhota hai, is liye reaction kam tez (garam karna parta hai; tez safed lau).

blocks.prompt:
j. Why the ionization energy of lithium is much lower than that of helium despite the fact that the nuclear charge of lithium is +3 and that of helium is +2.
Lithium ka nuclear charge +3 aur helium ka +2 hone ke bawajood lithium ki ionization energy helium se bohat kam kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Li (1s² 2s¹) ka 2s electron naye, door wale shell mein hai aur do 1s electrons use shield karte hain, is liye us par effective nuclear charge kam hai. He (1s²) ka electron poore bhare pehle shell se, nucleus ke qareeb, baghair shielding ke nikalta hai. Is liye He ki IE (2372) Li (520 kJ mol⁻¹) se kahin zyada hai (yeh values chapter se bahar ki hain).

blocks.prompt:
k. The ionization energy of Be (atomic no. 4) is higher than that of B (atomic no. 5), despite the fact that the nuclear charge of Be is +4 and that of B is +5.
Be ki ionization energy B se zyada hai halan ke Be ka nuclear charge +4 aur B ka +5 hai. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Be (1s² 2s²) ka 2s subshell poora bhara aur mustahkam hai. B (1s² 2s² 2p¹) mein akela 2p electron nikalta hai jo 2s se zyada energy rakhta hai aur 2s electrons use shield karte hain. Is liye asani se nikalta hai: B ki IE < Be ki IE.

blocks.prompt:
l. What is common in Na⁺, Mg²⁺, Al³⁺, Ne⁰ and F⁻? Arrange them in increasing order of sizes.
Na⁺, Mg²⁺, Al³⁺, Ne⁰ aur F⁻ mein kya cheez mushtarik hai? Inhein size ke barhte hue tarteeb dein.
blocks.explanation:
Sab isoelectronic hain (barabar electrons): har aik mein 10 electrons, 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ (neon jaisi configuration).
Electrons barabar hon to zyada protons cloud ko zyada kheenchte hain:
Al³⁺ (13 p) < Mg²⁺ (12 p) < Na⁺ (11 p) < Ne (10 p) < F⁻ (9 p)

blocks.prompt:
m. Consider the chlorides of sodium, magnesium, and phosphorus(V): NaCl, MgCl₂, and PCl₅
(i) Classify each of these chlorides as acidic, basic, or neutral.
(ii) For each chloride, briefly explain the reason for your classification, referring to their behavior when dissolved in water.
Sodium, magnesium aur phosphorus(V) ke chlorides NaCl, MgCl₂, PCl₅: (i) inhein acidic, basic ya neutral mein taqseem karein; (ii) pani mein in ke rawaiye se wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
(i) NaCl: neutral; MgCl₂: neutral (bohat halka acidic, pH 6.5); PCl₅: acidic. Koi basic nahi.
(ii) NaCl aur MgCl₂ ionic hain; sirf hal ho kar hydrated ions bante hain, hydrolysis (pani se toot-phoot) nahi:
NaCl(s) → Na⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq) (pH 7)
MgCl₂(s) → Mg²⁺(aq) + 2Cl⁻(aq) (pH 6.5)
PCl₅ covalent hai; pani se hydrolysis ho kar acids banata hai:
PCl₅ + 4H₂O → H₃PO₄ + 5HCl (pH 7 se kam) (yeh equation chapter se bahar ki hai)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: period 3 mein baen taraf ke chlorides (NaCl, MgCl₂) ionic aur neutral; Al se aage (AlCl₃, SiCl₄, PCl₃, PCl₅) covalent aur pani mein hydrolysis se HCl bana kar acidic.

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 Write equations for the reactions of Na and Mg with oxygen, chlorine, and water. Compare the reactivity of both elements with these in terms of metallic character.
Na aur Mg ke oxygen, chlorine aur pani ke saath reactions ki equations likhein. Metallic character ke lehaaz se dono ki reactivity ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Pani ke saath:
2Na(s) + 2H₂O(l) → 2NaOH(aq) + H₂(g) (thande pani se tez)
Mg(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Mg(OH)₂(aq) + H₂(g) (aahista)
Mg(s) + H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g) (bhaap se tez)
Oxygen ke saath:
2Na(s) + O₂(g) → Na₂O₂(s) (khuli hawa mein; peroxide)
4Na(s) + O₂(g) → 2Na₂O(s) (kam O₂ ya zyada temperature)
2Mg(s) + O₂(g) → 2MgO(s) (tez safed lau)
Chlorine ke saath:
2Na(s) + Cl₂(g) → 2NaCl(s) (exothermic, sunehri peeli lau)
Mg(s) + Cl₂(g) → MgCl₂(s)
Muqabla: Na (group 1) Mg (group 2) se zyada metallic hai: bara hai aur sirf aik electron chhorta hai (ionization energy kam), is liye pani, oxygen aur chlorine se zyada tez reaction karta hai. Na thande pani se zor se reaction karta hai aur kerosene mein rakha jata hai; Mg thande pani se aahista aur sirf bhaap se tez reaction karta hai, aur garam karne par hi oxygen mein jalta hai. Dono safed ionic solids (NaCl, MgCl₂, MgO) aur basic oxides/hydroxides banate hain.

rows: Chhota atom, kul ionization energy zyada
Thande pani se zor ka reaction
Thande pani se aahista; bhaap se tez
Hawa mein jal kar Na₂O₂ / Na₂O
Garam karne par tez safed lau, MgO

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Chapter (1.8) mein teen equations ghalat chhapi hain: "2Na(s) + O₂(g) → 2Na₂O₂(s)" balanced nahi (sahi: 2Na + O₂ → Na₂O₂); magnesium oxide ko gas "2MgO(g)" likha hai (yeh safed solid 2MgO(s) hai); aur bhaap wali equation "Mg(s) + 2H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g)" balanced nahi (sahi: Mg + H₂O → MgO + H₂). Jawab mein durust equations di gayi hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 Explain with the help of equations acidic and basic behavior of oxides and chlorides.
Oxides aur chlorides ke acidic aur basic rawaiye ko equations ki madad se wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Oxides:
1. Basic oxides: metals (group 1, 2) ke ionic oxides; pani se alkali dete hain.
Na₂O(s) + H₂O(l) → 2NaOH(aq)
CaO(s) + H₂O(l) → Ca(OH)₂(aq)
2. Amphoteric oxide (acid aur base dono se reaction): Al₂O₃ pani mein hal nahi hota magar acid aur base dono se reaction karta hai.
Al₂O₃(s) + 6HCl(aq) → 2AlCl₃ + 3H₂O(l)
Al₂O₃(s) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂Al₂O₄ + H₂O(l)
3. Acidic oxides: non-metals ke covalent oxides; pani se acids dete hain aur bases se reaction karte hain.
P₂O₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → 2H₃PO₃(aq)
SO₂(g) + H₂O(l) → H₂SO₃(aq)
SiO₂(s) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SiO₃(aq) + H₂O(l)
SO₂(g) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SO₃(aq) + H₂O(l)
Period 3 mein oxides basic (Na₂O, MgO) se amphoteric (Al₂O₃) aur phir acidic (SiO₂, P₄O₁₀, SO₃) hote jaate hain.
Chlorides:
1. Neutral chlorides: NaCl aur MgCl₂ (ionic) sirf hal ho kar hydrated ions banate hain, hydrolysis nahi.
NaCl(s) → Na⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq) (pH 7)
MgCl₂(s) → Mg²⁺(aq) + 2Cl⁻(aq) (pH 6.5)
2. Acidic chlorides: Al se S tak ke chlorides pani se hydrolysis ho kar HCl dete hain (pH 7 se kam).
AlCl₃(s) + 3H₂O(l) → Al(OH)₃(s) + 3HCl(aq)
SiCl₄(l) + 2H₂O(l) → SiO₂(s) + 4HCl(aq)
PCl₃(l) + 3H₂O(l) → H₃PO₃ + 3HCl(aq)
Period mein Cl se electronegativity ka farq ghatne se chlorides ka covalent character barhta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter (1.9.1) mein P₂O₃ + H₂O → H₃PO₃ balanced nahi chhapi; sahi: P₂O₃ + 3H₂O → 2H₃PO₃. Exam mein hamesha balanced equation likhein.

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 Describe the factors affecting and periodic trends of electron affinity.
Electron affinity par asar daalne wale factors aur us ke periodic trends bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Electron affinity (ΔH°ₑₐ₁): standard halat mein gas ke 1 mole atoms mein 1 mole electrons daal kar 1 mole uni-negative ions banne par enthalpy change.
Cl(g) + e⁻ → Cl⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹ (energy kharij, is liye negative)
Doosri electron affinity positive hai (energy jazb): O⁻(g) + e⁻ → O²⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₂ = +798 kJ mol⁻¹.
Factors:
1. Atom ka size: atom chhota to aane wale electron par nucleus ki kashish zyada, electron affinity zyada.
2. Nuclear charge: charge zyada to electron affinity zyada.
3. Electronic configuration: half-filled subshell wale atoms (N 2s² 2p³, P 3s² 3p³) ki electron affinity bohat kam; noble gases (ns² np⁶) electron qabool nahi karte (positive values).
Periodic trends:
1. Group mein neeche: size barhta, kashish ghatti, electron affinity aam tor par kam (kam negative): Li −60, Na −53, K −48, Rb −47, Cs −46 kJ mol⁻¹. Halogens mein At < I < Br < F < Cl; fluorine chlorine se kam kyun ke bohat chhote atom mein aane wala electron pehle se maujood 2p electrons se zyada dhakela jata hai (yeh wajah chapter se bahar ki hai).
2. Period mein: baen se daen electron affinity zyada negative, kyun ke nuclear charge barhta aur radius ghatta hai; har period mein halogens ki sab se zyada.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 Describe the factors affecting and periodic trends of ionization energy.
Ionization energy par asar daalne wale factors aur us ke periodic trends bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Ionization energy: gas ke aik mole atoms ke har atom se aik electron nikaal kar aik mole 1+ ions banane ki energy (ΔHᵢ₁), misal Na(g) → Na⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁ = 494 kJ mol⁻¹. Lagataar (successive) ionization energies barhti hain (Ca: 590, 1150, 4940 kJ mol⁻¹).
Factors:
1. Nuclear charge: effective nuclear charge zyada, kashish zyada, ionization energy zyada.
2. Atom ka size: atom bara, bahar ke electrons par pakar kamzor, ionization energy kam.
3. Electronic arrangement: half-filled aur poore bhare subshells zyada mustahkam, is liye ionization energy zyada; noble gases (ns² np⁶) ki sab se zyada; N (half-filled 2p³, 1403 kJ mol⁻¹) O se zyada.
4. Shielding effect: andar ke electrons zyada, screening zyada, ionization energy kam.
5. Spin-pair repulsion: paired electron (jaise O 2p⁴) unpaired (N) se thora asani se nikalta hai.
Periodic trends:
1. Group mein neeche: nuclear charge barhta hai magar size aur shielding zyada barhte hain, is liye ionization energy ghatti hai: Li > Na > K > Rb > Cs.
2. Period mein: shells wahi rehte, effective nuclear charge barhta, is liye ionization energy aam tor par barhti hai; har period mein alkali metals ki sab se kam aur noble gases ki sab se zyada. B (Be ke baad), O (N ke baad), Al (Mg ke baad) aur S (P ke baad) par halki kami aati hai.
